title: Base Bubbles
tagline: Your interactive lens into Base's ecosystem. Visualize, explore, and learn about protocols through an engaging bubble interface, with real-time analytics and gamified learning paths. Early discovery, simplified. 🔵
description:
Discover new projects, protocols, and opportunities as you sail through your learning adventure. You're always early when you're with Base Bubbles.

The vision is to make onchain feel less esoteric, simple and fun which is why it's an explorer that helps people at all levels and with every skill to be able to explore, interact without having to "read" about the guides on how to use a protocol/product built on Base and just have fun.

For consistent engagement, I've added gm streak where users have to maintain a streak and it breaks if you don't say gm for a day.

It's a social web app that will later on have community chats, gamified earnings while you're learning and interacting with protocols, AI agents to help you navigate and make the most out of best things out there in the ecosystem.
how_its_made: This project uses Next.js 14 with App Router for a snappy, modern UI, D3.js for interactive data visualizations, TailwindCSS for responsive styling, Privy for seamless web3 authentication, SWR for real-time data fetching, Dune Analytics integration for real-time protocol metrics and CDP (Coinbase Developer Platform) OnchainKit for Identity
